messages:
maria (AE): Heads-up: BigBank wants a POC showing streaming + immediate function/tool calls + strict structured JSON output. They also sent a security questionnaire and asked about pricing for sustained streams. Need quick plan.

devon (SE): Key constraints: need deterministic call ids for function calls in the stream, schema validation on final output, and retry semantics for dropped connections.

james (Eng): We can add a call_id to function_call chunks and surface that in streaming SDKs behind a feature flag. Small PR + tests.

maria (AE): They require at-most-once semantics for enrichment calls. Can we support that?

devon (SE): At-most-once is hard network-wise; recommend idempotent handlers using call_id. We'll demo dedupe pattern.

presales-bot: Security questionnaire link: https://redwood.internal/q/BB-SEC-2026 (partial answers).

sachin (SRE): Security: Hosted public API won't satisfy BigBank. Offer Dedicated in their VPC (fast) or Private on-prem (longer, ~2w). Need KMS, IP allowlist, 365d audit logs.

ellen (Prod): Pricing: sustained streaming costs are lower on Dedicated (reserved). I can model costs once we have token estimates.

maria (AE): Plan for POC (10 business days): devon -> demo flow, james -> SDK call_id flag + sample, sachin -> infra ETA, ellen -> cost estimate. I'll schedule customer demo.

james (Eng): I'll open the PR for call_id and add a tiny JS sample:
```js
for await (const ev of stream) {
  if (ev.type === 'function_call') handle({call_id: ev.call_id, name: ev.name});
  if (ev.type === 'structured_output' && ev.complete) validate(ev.json);
}
```

maria (AE): Great — thanks. I'll upload the questionnaire answers draft and confirm timeline with BigBank. :thumbsup:
